_comment: Source for /mlb-cards (tools/build-mlb-cards.mjs). Every price is a SportsCardsPro sold-listing range inside the 30-day window; n=0 + note 'scp-point' = SCP price point with no sale in the window (rendered with the 'pt' mark). Refresh with the Monday build; bump 'asof'.

players.name: Shohei Ohtani
players.note: The 2018 Topps Chrome Update HMT1 is the Ohtani rookie with real liquidity right now: 28 PSA 10 sales in 30 days with the middle of the tape at $900 to $1,000. The flagship US285 PSA 10 sits around $500 on similar volume.

players.name: José Ramírez
players.note: A 2014 rookie class with daily volume. The flagship RC trades $15 to $20 raw every day, the Heritage high-number SP is the sleeper at $75 to $100 raw, and the Topps Chrome Refractor PSA 10 is the four-figure card.

players.note: Neither 2017 Bowman Chrome auto printed a sale this month. The 2018 Bowman Chrome rookie auto is the only Acuña auto with PSA 10 comps inside the window, and the base RCs trade daily under $15.
